rule_or_requirement: User requests fixed-high-speed road reacquisition and continued progress after collision, accepting brief road excursions.
observable_information: Pixel road rows/full-width runs, last valid road direction and pixel speed drops. No simulator state enters policy.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four second candidates as causal repair plan: exact obstacle/impact, missing-row reconstruction, unwinding gate.
expected_success_endpoint: Three of three in selected causal probe, preserve both control finishes before full twelve cells
falsifier: No effective action change, no completion gain, lost prior finishes, unequal prefixes, lowered target or input leakage.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five arms times three consumed TRAIN cells=15 causal probe episodes
